snippet.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed | Gameplay Video | US | ESRB
snippet.description:
The heroes in a half shell are back with an exciting new gameplay trailer for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed!
Get ready to explore dynamic and interactive New York locations as our favourite pizza-loving crime-fighters emerge from the sewers and onto PC and consoles on 18th October 2024
Spoiler: PlayMates toys available only at Walmart 
#TMNT #TMNTMutantsUnleashed
